title: MT60131: Advanced Composite Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, classification, fabrication of composites; strengthening
mechanisms, mechanics of composite materials, design of composites;
Reinforcements, production and treatment of particles and fibres,
characterisation of composites, interfaces; cast metal matrix, powder
metallurgical and in-situ composites - metal-polymer, metal-ceramic and metalmetal composites; applications of cerments, diamond tools, superalloys,
discontinuously reinforced aluminium composites.
